#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path


OWNER = "stebolainen"
REPO = "gneu-se"
REPO_FULL = f"{OWNER}/{REPO}"
BASE_REF = "main"

API = "https://api.github.com"
API_VERSION = "2022-11-28"

WEEK_RE = re.compile(r"^\d{4}-W\d{2}$")
SHA_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{40}$")
SHA256_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")

EXPECTED_PLAN_KEYS = {
    "schema",
    "action",
    "owner",
    "repo",
    "edition",
    "base_ref",
    "base_sha",
    "head_ref",
    "commit_message",
    "pr_title",
    "pr_body",
    "files",
}

EXPECTED_FILE_KEYS = {
    "path",
    "sha256",
    "size",
}

MAX_CANDIDATE = 400_000
MAX_REPORT = 50_000


def fail(msg: str) -> None:
    raise SystemExit("BLOCKED: " + msg)


def canonical_json(obj: object) -> bytes:
    return (
        json.dumps(
            obj,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
        + "\n"
    ).encode("utf-8")


def load_canonical(
    path: Path,
    label: str,
) -> tuple[dict, bytes]:

    if path.is_symlink():
        fail(f"{label} symlink forbidden")

    if not path.is_file():
        fail(f"{label} missing")

    raw = path.read_bytes()

    try:
        data = json.loads(raw)
    except Exception:
        fail(f"{label} invalid JSON")

    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        fail(f"{label} must be object")

    if raw != canonical_json(data):
        fail(f"{label} not canonical JSON")

    return data, raw


def hash_bytes(raw: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def normalized_report(path: Path) -> bytes:
    if path.is_symlink():
        fail("report symlink forbidden")

    if not path.is_file():
        fail("report missing")

    raw = path.read_bytes()

    if len(raw) > MAX_REPORT:
        fail("report too large")

    try:
        text = raw.decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        fail("report not UTF-8")

    if "\x00" in text:
        fail("report contains NUL")

    text = text.rstrip() + "\n"

    if len(text.strip()) < 200:
        fail("report too short")

    return text.encode("utf-8")


def validate_inputs(
    plan_path: Path,
    candidate_path: Path,
    report_path: Path,
) -> tuple[dict, bytes, bytes]:

    plan, _ = load_canonical(
        plan_path,
        "plan",
    )

    if set(plan) != EXPECTED_PLAN_KEYS:
        fail("plan schema mismatch")

    if plan["schema"] != "gneu-aihot-pr-plan-v1":
        fail("unsupported plan schema")

    if plan["action"] != "create-pr":
        fail("executor only accepts create-pr")

    if plan["owner"] != OWNER:
        fail("owner mismatch")

    if plan["repo"] != REPO:
        fail("repo mismatch")

    if plan["base_ref"] != BASE_REF:
        fail("base ref must be main")

    edition = plan["edition"]

    if (
        not isinstance(edition, str)
        or not WEEK_RE.fullmatch(edition)
    ):
        fail("invalid edition")

    base_sha = plan["base_sha"]

    if (
        not isinstance(base_sha, str)
        or not SHA_RE.fullmatch(base_sha)
    ):
        fail("invalid base SHA")

    expected_head = f"aihot/{edition}"

    if plan["head_ref"] != expected_head:
        fail("head ref mismatch")

    if plan["head_ref"] == "main":
        fail("main head forbidden")

    if not plan["head_ref"].startswith("aihot/"):
        fail("head prefix forbidden")

    for key in (
        "commit_message",
        "pr_title",
        "pr_body",
    ):
        value = plan[key]

        if (
            not isinstance(value, str)
            or not value.strip()
        ):
            fail(f"{key} invalid")

    files = plan["files"]

    if (
        not isinstance(files, list)
        or len(files) != 2
    ):
        fail("plan must contain exactly 2 files")

    expected_paths = {
        "data/aihot.json",
        f"aihot/drafts/{edition}.report.md",
    }

    actual_paths: set[str] = set()

    by_path: dict[str, dict] = {}

    for item in files:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            fail("plan file entry invalid")

        if set(item) != EXPECTED_FILE_KEYS:
            fail("plan file schema mismatch")

        path = item["path"]

        if not isinstance(path, str):
            fail("plan file path invalid")

        if path in actual_paths:
            fail("duplicate plan file")

        actual_paths.add(path)
        by_path[path] = item

        digest = item["sha256"]

        if (
            not isinstance(digest, str)
            or not SHA256_RE.fullmatch(digest)
        ):
            fail("plan file SHA-256 invalid")

        size = item["size"]

        if (
            not isinstance(size, int)
            or size < 1
        ):
            fail("plan file size invalid")

    if actual_paths != expected_paths:
        fail("unexpected file set")

    candidate, candidate_raw = load_canonical(
        candidate_path,
        "candidate",
    )

    if len(candidate_raw) > MAX_CANDIDATE:
        fail("candidate too large")

    if set(candidate) != {
        "generated",
        "editions",
        "articles",
    }:
        fail("candidate schema mismatch")

    report_raw = normalized_report(
        report_path
    )

    expected_candidate = by_path[
        "data/aihot.json"
    ]

    if len(candidate_raw) != expected_candidate["size"]:
        fail("candidate size differs from plan")

    if (
        hash_bytes(candidate_raw)
        != expected_candidate["sha256"]
    ):
        fail("candidate hash differs from plan")

    report_repo_path = (
        f"aihot/drafts/{edition}.report.md"
    )

    expected_report = by_path[
        report_repo_path
    ]

    if len(report_raw) != expected_report["size"]:
        fail("report size differs from plan")

    if (
        hash_bytes(report_raw)
        != expected_report["sha256"]
    ):
        fail("report hash differs from plan")

    return plan, candidate_raw, report_raw


def api(
    method: str,
    path: str,
    token: str,
    body: dict | None = None,
    allow_status: set[int] | None = None,
) -> tuple[int, object]:

    allowed = allow_status or set()

    raw_body = (
        json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8")
        if body is not None
        else None
    )

    req = urllib.request.Request(
        API + path,
        data=raw_body,
        method=method,
        headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
            "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
            "X-GitHub-Api-Version": API_VERSION,
            "User-Agent": "gneu-aihot-pr-executor/1.0",
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
    )

    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(
            req,
            timeout=30,
        ) as response:
            status = response.status
            raw = response.read()

    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        status = exc.code

        if status not in allowed:
            fail(
                f"GitHub API HTTP {status}"
            )

        raw = exc.read()

    except Exception as exc:
        fail(
            "GitHub API failure: "
            + type(exc).__name__
        )

    if not raw:
        return status, {}

    try:
        return status, json.loads(raw)
    except Exception:
        fail("GitHub API returned invalid JSON")


def branch(
    token: str,
    name: str,
) -> dict | None:

    encoded = urllib.parse.quote(
        name,
        safe="",
    )

    status, data = api(
        "GET",
        (
            f"/repos/{REPO_FULL}/"
            f"branches/{encoded}"
        ),
        token,
        allow_status={404},
    )

    if status == 404:
        return None

    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        fail("branch response invalid")

    return data


def require_current_main(
    token: str,
    expected_sha: str,
) -> None:

    data = branch(
        token,
        "main",
    )

    if data is None:
        fail("main branch missing")

    commit = data.get("commit")

    if not isinstance(commit, dict):
        fail("main commit response invalid")

    actual = commit.get("sha")

    if actual != expected_sha:
        fail(
            "main moved: expected "
            f"{expected_sha[:12]} got "
            f"{str(actual)[:12]}"
        )


def create_blob(
    token: str,
    raw: bytes,
) -> str:

    _, data = api(
        "POST",
        f"/repos/{REPO_FULL}/git/blobs",
        token,
        {
            "content":
                base64.b64encode(
                    raw
                ).decode("ascii"),
            "encoding": "base64",
        },
    )

    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        fail("blob response invalid")

    sha = data.get("sha")

    if (
        not isinstance(sha, str)
        or not SHA_RE.fullmatch(sha)
    ):
        fail("invalid blob SHA")

    return sha


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()

    parser.add_argument(
        "--plan",
        required=True,
    )

    parser.add_argument(
        "--candidate",
        required=True,
    )

    parser.add_argument(
        "--report",
        required=True,
    )

    parser.add_argument(
        "--validate-only",
        action="store_true",
    )

    args = parser.parse_args()

    plan, candidate_raw, report_raw = (
        validate_inputs(
            Path(args.plan),
            Path(args.candidate),
            Path(args.report),
        )
    )

    edition = plan["edition"]
    base_sha = plan["base_sha"]
    head_ref = plan["head_ref"]

    print("AIHOT_PR_EXECUTOR_INPUT: PASS")
    print("edition:", edition)
    print("base_main:", base_sha)
    print("head_ref:", head_ref)

    if args.validate_only:
        print(
            "AIHOT_PR_EXECUTOR: "
            "VALIDATE_ONLY_PASS"
        )
        return

    token = os.environ.get(
        "AIHOT_PR_WRITER_TOKEN",
        "",
    )

    if len(token) < 20:
        fail(
            "AIHOT_PR_WRITER_TOKEN missing"
        )

    # Before creating any reachable Git object,
    # main must still equal the validated base.
    require_current_main(
        token,
        base_sha,
    )

    if branch(token, head_ref) is not None:
        fail("target AI-hot branch already exists")

    # Read exact base commit/tree.
    _, base_commit = api(
        "GET",
        (
            f"/repos/{REPO_FULL}/"
            f"git/commits/{base_sha}"
        ),
        token,
    )

    if not isinstance(base_commit, dict):
        fail("base commit response invalid")

    tree = base_commit.get("tree")

    if not isinstance(tree, dict):
        fail("base tree response invalid")

    base_tree_sha = tree.get("sha")

    if (
        not isinstance(base_tree_sha, str)
        or not SHA_RE.fullmatch(base_tree_sha)
    ):
        fail("base tree SHA invalid")

    # Unattached objects are harmless if a later
    # race check blocks publication.
    candidate_blob = create_blob(
        token,
        candidate_raw,
    )

    report_blob = create_blob(
        token,
        report_raw,
    )

    report_repo_path = (
        f"aihot/drafts/{edition}.report.md"
    )

    _, tree_result = api(
        "POST",
        f"/repos/{REPO_FULL}/git/trees",
        token,
        {
            "base_tree": base_tree_sha,
            "tree": [
                {
                    "path": "data/aihot.json",
                    "mode": "100644",
                    "type": "blob",
                    "sha": candidate_blob,
                },
                {
                    "path": report_repo_path,
                    "mode": "100644",
                    "type": "blob",
                    "sha": report_blob,
                },
            ],
        },
    )

    if not isinstance(tree_result, dict):
        fail("tree response invalid")

    new_tree_sha = tree_result.get("sha")

    if (
        not isinstance(new_tree_sha, str)
        or not SHA_RE.fullmatch(new_tree_sha)
    ):
        fail("new tree SHA invalid")

    _, commit_result = api(
        "POST",
        f"/repos/{REPO_FULL}/git/commits",
        token,
        {
            "message": plan["commit_message"],
            "tree": new_tree_sha,
            "parents": [base_sha],
        },
    )

    if not isinstance(commit_result, dict):
        fail("commit response invalid")

    commit_sha = commit_result.get("sha")

    if (
        not isinstance(commit_sha, str)
        or not SHA_RE.fullmatch(commit_sha)
    ):
        fail("new commit SHA invalid")

    # Race check immediately before making
    # anything reachable.
    require_current_main(
        token,
        base_sha,
    )

    if branch(token, head_ref) is not None:
        fail(
            "target branch appeared "
            "during execution"
        )

    _, ref_result = api(
        "POST",
        f"/repos/{REPO_FULL}/git/refs",
        token,
        {
            "ref": f"refs/heads/{head_ref}",
            "sha": commit_sha,
        },
    )

    if not isinstance(ref_result, dict):
        fail("ref response invalid")

    created_ref = ref_result.get("ref")

    if created_ref != f"refs/heads/{head_ref}":
        fail("created unexpected ref")

    # Main may have moved after the branch ref was
    # created. Refuse to open a PR against any base
    # other than the exact validated main snapshot.
    require_current_main(
        token,
        base_sha,
    )

    _, pr = api(
        "POST",
        f"/repos/{REPO_FULL}/pulls",
        token,
        {
            "title": plan["pr_title"],
            "body": plan["pr_body"],
            "head": head_ref,
            "base": "main",
            "maintainer_can_modify": False,
        },
    )

    if not isinstance(pr, dict):
        fail("PR response invalid")

    number = pr.get("number")

    if (
        not isinstance(number, int)
        or number < 1
    ):
        fail("invalid PR number")

    if pr.get("state") != "open":
        fail("created PR is not open")

    head = pr.get("head")
    base = pr.get("base")

    if (
        not isinstance(head, dict)
        or not isinstance(base, dict)
    ):
        fail("PR refs invalid")

    if head.get("ref") != head_ref:
        fail("PR head ref mismatch")

    if head.get("sha") != commit_sha:
        fail("PR head SHA mismatch")

    if base.get("ref") != "main":
        fail("PR base ref mismatch")

    if base.get("sha") != base_sha:
        fail(
            "PR base SHA mismatch: expected "
            f"{base_sha[:12]} got "
            f"{str(base.get('sha'))[:12]}"
        )

    # Final exact changed-file check.
    _, changed = api(
        "GET",
        (
            f"/repos/{REPO_FULL}/"
            f"pulls/{number}/files"
            "?per_page=100"
        ),
        token,
    )

    if not isinstance(changed, list):
        fail("PR changed files response invalid")

    filenames = sorted(
        str(row.get("filename"))
        for row in changed
        if isinstance(row, dict)
    )

    expected = sorted([
        "data/aihot.json",
        report_repo_path,
    ])

    if filenames != expected:
        fail(
            "created PR changed-file set "
            "is not exact"
        )

    print("AIHOT_PR_CREATE: PASS")
    print("pr:", number)
    print("head_sha:", commit_sha)
    print("base_sha:", base_sha)
    print("files:", len(filenames))
    print("merge: NOT_PERFORMED")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
